replies.body:
Hello,

The Moderator who punished you has provided sufficient evidence of you hacking. Your punishment is valid, and it'll remain. Thus, this appeal is denied. You can appeal in 5-6 months.

Best Regards,
Zeusy,
Avicus Senior Moderator
